programs.name: Pretrial Supervised Release Program (Probation)
programs.summary: Started July 2017 (funded by the Community Corrections Partnership). Pretrial Compliance Officers supervise people released on supervised release according to risk level, install and monitor GPS, respond to SCRAM alcohol-monitor alerts, and write progress/violation reports; risk is assessed with the VPRAI-R tool.

programs.name: Veterans Treatment Court
programs.summary: Serves justice-involved military veterans with addiction, serious mental illness or co-occurring disorders; runs in Santa Maria (since 2011), Santa Barbara (2012) and Lompoc (2016) with VA partners and veteran mentors. May help dismiss a case, reduce felonies to misdemeanors, or avoid jail. Optional MIL-100 form tells the court about your service.

programs.name: Criminal calendar rules (no walk-ins)
programs.summary: Clerks cannot extend arraignment/hearing dates but can advance them. Calendars are set a day ahead — no walk-in hearings. If you have a warrant, calendar your case by 12:00 p.m. the day before; other requests need 2 days' notice. Missing court means a warrant.

programs.name: Probation Report & Resource Centers (PRRC)
programs.summary: Probation lists PRRCs in Santa Barbara (4500 Hollister Ave., (805) 692-4890) and Santa Maria (124 Carmen Ln, (805) 346-7620).

jails.name: Santa Barbara County Main Jail
jails.phone_note: Main Jail line from Sheriff 'Who Is In Custody' page. Social visits are non-contact through a window; max 2 per week; schedules PDF on the Visit an Inmate page. Deposits: TouchPayOnline online, by phone 866-232-1899 (Site ID 293110), or 24-hour kiosk in the lobby.
jails.note: Sheriff: houses male and female inmates, pretrial and sentenced. The Sheriff's visit page also links separate 'IRC' and 'Northwest' visitation-hour sheets for Santa Barbara.

jails.name: Northern Branch Jail
jails.phone_note: Visits for this facility are scheduled online (Via Path) and held here Sun–Sat 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., on the hour. Deposit kiosk on site; TouchPayOnline by phone 866-232-1899 (Site ID 293110).
jails.note: Sheriff: 376-bed facility opened January 2022; houses male and female inmates in medium and high security; 32 medical/mental health beds.
